Plot calibration results for all target types and iterations

plot_calibration_targets.Rd

Reads calibration target output files from each iteration and creates comparison plots of simulated versus target values. Supports biomass, abundance, weight at age, and catch targets.

Usage

plot_calibration_targets(
  run_dir = here::here("RUN"),
  data_dir = here::here("inputs", "data"),
  settings_dir = here::here("inputs"),
  output_dir = here::here("outputs"),
  parameter_file = here::here("inputs", "parameter_table.csv"),
  output_prefix = "outputSETAS"
)

Arguments

run_dir

Character. Path to the RUN directory containing iteration folders (e.g., i0, i1, i2, ...). Default: here::here("RUN").

data_dir

Character. Path to the directory containing target CSV files (e.g., <Code>_<var.type>.csv). Default: here::here("inputs", "data").

settings_dir

Character. Path to the directory containing calibration settings files (calibration_settings_*.csv). Default: here::here("inputs").

output_dir

Character. Directory where PDF plots are saved. Default: here::here("outputs").

parameter_file

Character. Path to the parameter table CSV file with an IsCalibrated column. Used to identify groups to plot. Default: here::here("inputs", "parameter_table.csv").

output_prefix

Character. Prefix for biomass index file name (e.g., "outputSETAS" for "outputSETASBiomIndx.txt"). Default: "outputSETAS".

Value

Invisibly, a named list of data frames containing the processed data for each target type.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  plot_calibration_targets(
    run_dir = here::here("RUN"),
    data_dir = here::here("inputs", "data"),
    settings_dir = here::here("inputs"),
    output_dir = here::here("outputs")
  )
} # }
